title: Onyx: 15 Years of Videos, History & Violence
original_title: Onyx: 15 Years of Videos, History & Violence
plot: One of a kind DVD showcases not only fifteen years of ONYX's music videos, but never before seen footage of live shows, studio sessions, record signings, music video shoots, personal moments and general chaos. Special features include five solo videos, audio commentary on all seventeen videos from Fredro Starr and Sticky Fingaz, Slam karaoke, an exclusive photo gallery and other madface goodies.
